TROUBLESHOOTING FLOW-CHART

Trouble No. 1    No Shifting

Warm up engine
Coolant temp.: 80°C (176°F)
ATF temp.:      50 – 80°C (122 – 176°F)

|
v

Connect a voltmeter to check connector
terminals T1 and E1.
Does T1 terminal voltage vary with changes
in throttle opening?

Yes                                    No
|                                       |
v                                       v
                    Is voltage between ECT ECU terminals           No ——> Brake signal
                    BK+ and BK– as follows?                              faulty
                    0V : Brake pedal released
                    12V : Brake pedal depressed
                                       |
                                      Yes
                                       |
                                       v
                    • ECU power source and ground faulty
                    • Throttle position signal faulty
                    • T1 terminal wire open or short

|
v

Disconnect ECT ECU connector and road           No ——> Transmission faulty
test. Does the transmission operate in the
respective gear when in the following ranges
while driving?
D range ..... Overdrive
2 range ..... 3rd gear
L range ..... 1st gear

Yes
